name: Threshold memristor held-out pulse
source:
// Published threshold-model pulse protocol; synthetic simulation, not a physical-device fit.
// A sub-threshold read pulse surrounds one signed write pulse so state change is observable.
external_subcircuit two_terminal MEM (p1,p2) file="models/memristor.lib" entry=memristor sha256=cd4bac38581fb00c1b5667e9d5ec440cf954efb5e26105ae2775853cc90301f6 version=1.0.0 license=BSD-3-Clause source="Ngspice Pershin-Di-Ventra threshold example; see MEMRISTOR_NOTICE.md" simulator=ngspice redistribution=permitted instance_parameters="Rinit:Ohm,Vt:V,stime:s"

param initial_resistance: Ohm = 7k
param switching_threshold: V = 1.6V
param pulse_amplitude: V = 3V
param pulse_duration: s = 3ns
param timestep: s = 25ps

net GND
net IN
net TOP

source VIN pwl(0s,0V, 200ps,0V, 250ps,0.4V, 750ps,0.4V, 800ps,0V, 1.3ns,0V, 1.35ns,{pulse_amplitude}, {1.35ns+pulse_duration},{pulse_amplitude}, {1.4ns+pulse_duration},0V, {2ns+pulse_duration},0V, {2.05ns+pulse_duration},0.4V, {2.55ns+pulse_duration},0.4V, {2.6ns+pulse_duration},0V, 12ns,0V)
source VSENSE 0V
device XM MEM (Rinit={initial_resistance}, Vt={switching_threshold})

connect VIN.minus, XM.p2 to GND
connect VIN.plus, VSENSE.plus to IN
connect VSENSE.minus, XM.p1 to TOP

simulate tran {timestep} 12ns uic
